samples.claim: DeletionFile path is {root}/_deletions/{fragment_id}-{read_version}-{id}.{extension}. Nested DeletionFileType is ARROW_ARRAY=0 (one Arrow IPC batch containing one Int32Array column, .arrow) or BITMAP=1 (Roaring bitmap, .bin). Comments motivate sparse versus dense selection but provide no threshold. Fields are file_type=1, read_version=2, concurrent-writer differentiating id=3, num_deleted_rows=4, and optional base_id=7 for Manifest.base_paths. Deletions operate on offsets, not stable logical IDs.

samples.claim: Public CountsMatrix derives Clone/Debug/PartialEq/Eq with private destination count, block rows, total old physical rows u64 (including deleted), and row-major cumulative Vec<u32>. 88 | /// Cumulative per-destination row counts at every block boundary.
89 | ///
90 | /// Row `b` of the grid holds, for each destination label `d`, the number of

92 | /// the total row count of every destination. Deleted (NULL-labeled) rows are
93 | /// not counted; the deleted count of a block is implied by
94 | /// `block length - sum of per-label deltas`.

99 |     /// Source rows per block. Only the final block may be shorter.
100 |     block_rows: u32,
101 |     /// Total physical source rows, including deleted rows.
102 |     total_rows: u64,
103 |     /// `num_blocks * num_destinations` cumulative counts, row-major by block.

self_sufficiency.review_note: Five answers attempted from KB only; source snippets were used for separate accuracy checks, not to fill missing scenario answers. Python module document is still absent.

answers.write_then_compact: FAIL. KB has schema projection, metadata, local remapping and lineage codecs but lacks Dataset::write/file creation, complete compact_files scheduling, index remap orchestration, publication and cleanup/memory lifecycle.
answers.new_scalar_index: FAIL. Metadata envelopes, filter primitives, cache and staleness contracts are covered; complete index traits/factories/planners, persistence/update/remap, tests and bindings remain missing.
answers.v2_format: FAIL. Exact version identities/gates and protobuf contracts are partly reconstructed. Row-ID payload bytes/validation and bitmap comment discrepancy are now documented, but full v2 page byte algorithms, reader/writer dispatch and historical fixtures remain absent.
answers.python_api: FAIL. Contributor policy alone cannot supply every Python/PyO3 API, signature, conversion and Rust target. L1 Python module is not yet present.
answers.transaction_commit: FAIL. Local refresh/rechunk/lineage serialization is documented, including standalone Ranges panic, but operation triggers/conflict matrix, preload scheduling, retry/rebase, atomic publication and unknown-outcome handling remain incomplete.
